previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Descriptor faults and cleanup use numeric FD identity without a safe generation handoff
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: Observed lease closes concurrently with fault_close_observed_lease; output descriptor changes between fstat and dup2/close; sink close races its reader.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: The fstat identity check and the subsequent numeric os.close/dup2 are separate unsynchronized operations. Native lease close sets fd=None and releases its FD; a concurrently evaluated old integer can be reused before the fault syscall. close_fd never verifies the registered birth at all. A reader can also issue read on the number after close/reuse. These paths can affect a different descriptor generation and cannot be described as safe owned-resource races merely from the earlier inode tuple.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Limit faults to a qualified original owner-thread/loop handoff with retained generation and no concurrent release/reuse, or explicitly refuse that fault when this ownership cannot be established. Join/detach the corresponding reader before releasing its descriptor. Validate cleanup against the exact active registered generation, including only explicitly owned replacements; preserve uncertainty instead of closing an unowned number.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static unsafe check/use races; no descriptor race, close, dup2, or FD acquisition executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: No raw borrowed-FD close or dup2. Unsafe original FD and task handoffs explicitly refuse; owned output-close callback only retained original loop/thread/context. Reader actually detached/joined before exact fixture generation release; input actor checked; unknown generation retained no retry/repin.
